description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of a variable categorized by the number of matches, displaying a total of seven distinct slices. The segments are arranged in a clockwise direction starting from the top, ordered sequentially by their categorical labels from 6 down to 0, rather than by their proportional size. The largest slice, labeled "6 Matches," is colored light blue-grey and accounts for 27.2% (8006) of the total. Continuing clockwise, the slice labeled "5" is light blue and represents 10.4% (3043), followed by the slice labeled "4" in very light blue at 6.2% (1810). The next segment, labeled "3," is light olive green and makes up 6.8% (2002), while the slice labeled "2" is pale yellow-green and constitutes 22.4% (6583). The remaining two slices are labeled "1," colored light peach-yellow at 13.8% (4046), and "0," colored pale cream at 13.3% (3910). The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, the categorical labels are positioned just outside the perimeter of each corresponding segment. Both the percentage and the raw count (enclosed in parentheses) are displayed directly inside each slice. All slices are contiguous and separated by thin white borders, with no segments visually emphasized through exploding, offsetting, or bolding.
